what_went_wrong: Saturday 2026-08-29 was answered as a Friday and the weekend as a working day, because the planner re-derived the day from the work it found on the calendar.
The user delegated the ordinary placements and was asked for an exact gym time and a morning start anyway.
The advance produced another recap instead of a reviewable artifact.
sanitization: No tokens, credentials, or provider identifiers.
No raw model reasoning, prompts, or tool arguments.
No calendar event identifiers: the recording never reaches a calendar, so it carries none.
The owner is a placeholder id; the session key is the Slack channel/thread pair the plan prescribes.
Every payload below is parsed by the production contracts, whose extra="forbid" refuses anything that is not a declared field.
